obraz: The lid holds, and holds, and gives under your grip.
proc: Resistance gives way to a bodily force that was already there.
Resistance gives way to a strength that was already there.

obraz: One seat is left on the last bus, and two of you are still on the pavement.
proc: There is not enough for both, and the lack presses a choice.
Lack: there is not enough for both.

obraz: A friend copies the way you tap your foot, and you had never noticed it.
proc: You see yourself through another person as in a mirror.
One sees oneself through another person as in a mirror.

obraz: The raven calls once from the roof, and everyone at the door looks up.
proc: A single sound arrives and changes what everyone does.
A sound arrives and changes the moment for everyone.

obraz: The footbridge sways under the crowd and is still again when they have crossed.
proc: The bridge bends under strain and does not break.
It bends under load and holds without breaking.

obraz: The table has moved through three homes and still stands in the kitchen.
proc: A thing handed on through homes and still carried forward.
A thing carried on from home to home.

obraz: Someone has remembered how you take your coffee.
proc: A small uncounted gift of attention from one person to another.
An uncounted small gift passing between two people.

obraz: The cloud lifts, and you see how far up the slope you already are.
proc: Light comes and you see where you stand.
Light returns and one sees where one stands.

obraz: The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
proc: What is left standing unused loses its strength.
What is left unused loses its strength.

obraz: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the queue turns round as one.
proc: An outside force breaks the plan that looked solid.
An uninvited outside force breaks the plan.

obraz: Two people walk side by side, and neither could say who set the pace.
proc: Two find a shared rhythm with neither forcing the other.
Two share a rhythm that neither imposed.

obraz: Your foot is already off the kerb when the horn sounds.
proc: A sharp stop at the threshold just as the move is being made.
A move is stopped just before it is made, and the stop protects.

obraz: The lift stops between floors, and the building goes on humming around it.
proc: Something that was moving has stopped and is held between states.
Movement has stopped and is held in place.

obraz: The dough rests under a tea towel, and by morning it has doubled.
proc: Covered and unseen, something completes itself within.
Covered and seemingly idle, it completes itself within.

obraz: The new bulb in the hallway shows a crack that was always in the ceiling.
proc: A small light reveals what was there all along.
A light reveals what was there all along.

obraz: The seal has dived, and everyone on the shore watches a different patch of water.
proc: Something moves under the surface where no one can see it.
The seal exists but is not shown; nobody knows where yet.

obraz: A new document is open, and the cursor blinks on the first line.
proc: An open unmarked space where nothing has been written yet.
An open unwritten space waiting for meaning.

obraz: You write down the teacher's words, not yet knowing what they are for.
proc: The words exist but their meaning is not yet known.
The meaning of the words exists but is not yet known.

obraz: You turn down the praise and say whose work it was.
proc: Taking the honest side and knowingly giving up the credit.
Choosing the honest side knowingly at one's own cost.

obraz: The salmon throws itself at the falls again.
proc: Raw bodily force thrown against resistance.
Raw bodily force thrown against a resistance.

obraz: The birch on the lava field grows along the one crack that holds soil.
proc: Constraint shows the one thing truly needed for growth.
Constraint shows the one thing that is truly needed.

obraz: In the dark window of the train your own face sits among the other passengers.
proc: One's own face seen among other people in a mirror.
Seeing oneself among others, literally in a mirror.

obraz: The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
proc: A road made by going, step after step.
A road literally made by going.

obraz: The tall grass lies flat in the wind and is standing again by evening.
proc: It bends under the force and does not break.
It bends under strain and does not break.

obraz: The stream runs in the bed the old river cut.
proc: The present follows a way handed down by what came before.
The new follows a way inherited from what came before.

obraz: The rowan feeds the thrush, and the thrush carries its seed over the hill.
proc: An exchange between two sides that benefits both, uncounted.
Each side gives to the other without counting.

obraz: The low sun comes in under the cloud, and every stone on the moor has a shadow.
proc: The sun simply shines and shows where everything stands.
The sun's light shows where everything stands.

obraz: The pool cut off from the river clouds over while the river runs clear.
proc: What stops moving spoils while what flows stays strong.
What stands still loses its strength while what moves stays alive.

obraz: A power cut ends the video call and takes the unsaved slide with it.
proc: An uninvited outside force breaks things and shows what is gone.
An outside force breaks the plan and shows what is gone.

obraz: Two people carry a long mirror through the doorway, one pausing as the other turns.
proc: Two move together by adjusting to each other's rhythm.
Two move together by matching rhythm, neither forcing.

obraz: The answer is already on your tongue, and you take one long breath before it.
proc: A stop just before the move is made.
A pause at the threshold stops the rush before speaking.

obraz: The tree planted as a sapling beside the bench now shades the place where you sit.
proc: Something done long ago has ripened in its own time.
Something done long ago has ripened into a result over time.

obraz: The broken bone knits under the cast, and nothing can be seen of it.
proc: Nothing shows outside while it completes itself within.
Nothing shows outside while it completes itself within.

obraz: One match in the cave shows the wall an arm's length away and no further.
proc: A small flame that reveals only a little.
A small flame reveals a limited piece of what was there.

obraz: The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
proc: Guarded openness that does not let everything in.
Guarded openness that looks out but does not let everything in.

obraz: One wall in the new flat is still bare, without a single nail hole.
proc: An unmarked surface with no sign on it yet.
An unmarked space with nothing written on it yet.

obraz: Halfway through the dishes a song comes on, and you both join in.
proc: Shared joy in the middle of the work, not at the end.
Shared joy arriving in the middle of a task.

obraz: The child struggles with the zip, and you wait while they try again.
proc: Something fragile is given room rather than forced.
Care that gives a small one room instead of forcing.

obraz: The door swollen by rain opens at the third push of your shoulder.
proc: Resistance gives way to bodily strength.
Resistance yields to bodily strength.

obraz: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
proc: What was moving is stopped and held as it is.
What was moving has stopped and is held as it is.

obraz: Your foot finds the brake as the car ahead drifts, before you know why.
proc: Something is sensed and acted on before it can be explained.
Something is sensed and acted on before it can be explained.

obraz: On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
proc: The rhythm of the road raises the question whether it still leads where you meant.
The rhythm of the road hides whether it still leads where intended.

obraz: The runner slows to a walk on the hill and does not stop.
proc: Enduring a long strain by yielding without breaking off.
Enduring the strain by yielding without breaking off.

obraz: You read the same message again in the morning, and it says something else.
proc: After the turn from night to day the same thing looks different.
After the turn from night to morning the same thing looks different.

obraz: A gift you did not ask for sits on your table, still in its paper.
proc: A gift between two sides, though still closed and unknown.
The gift is there but still closed and unknown.

obraz: The sun comes round to the window, and every fingerprint on the glass shows.
proc: The sun's light shows everything as it stands.
Sunlight simply shines and shows everything as it is.

obraz: The bucket under the spring is full, and the water goes on running over its brim.
proc: Value keeps flowing on rather than being held still.
The flow keeps moving past what merely holds it.

obraz: One minute of hail, and the tulips are lying on the path.
proc: A sudden outside force breaks what stood.
An uninvited outside force flattens what stood.

obraz: Two swans cross the lake, and the gap between them never changes.
proc: Two move in a steady common rhythm.
Two move in a common rhythm, neither pulling ahead.

obraz: One person says the name no one has said all evening, and the table goes quiet.
proc: A spoken word arrives and changes the room.
A spoken word arrives and changes the room.

obraz: After months of practice, you answer in the new language without translating first.
proc: Long earlier work shows as a result that could not be hurried.
Long earlier work shows as a result that could not be hurried.

obraz: The potato forgotten in the cupboard has put out white shoots.
proc: Closed away and unnoticed, something has grown from within.
Shut away and unseen, something has been growing within.

obraz: You bring a dish to the shared dinner and leave with a plate of someone else's cooking.
proc: Giving and receiving between hands, uncounted.
Giving and receiving between sides, uncounted.

obraz: The phone is silenced for the night, with three numbers allowed to ring through.
proc: A guard that stays open to some and lets not everything in.
A guard that stays open to some and lets not everything in.

obraz: Fresh snow lies on the field, and nothing has crossed it yet.
proc: An unmarked open space with no sign on it.
An unmarked open surface where nothing has been written yet.

obraz: Dinner is burnt, and the table laughs over bread and cheese.
proc: Shared lightness in the middle of things going wrong.
Shared joy in the middle of things, not as a reward.

obraz: The seedling droops for a week in its new pot, then puts out one leaf.
proc: Fragile new life, given room, begins to grow.
Fragile new life given room, then growing a little.

obraz: The reply is written in a single breath, and your thumb stops above the send button.
proc: A stop just before a rushed move is made.
A rushed move is halted just before it is made.

obraz: A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
proc: Movement is halted and held in view under the ice.
Something moving under the surface shows itself only by a trace.

obraz: You turn back at the door, sure something is left behind, before you know what.
proc: Something is sensed before it can be explained.
Something is sensed before it can be explained.

obraz: After the first hour of walking your feet stop asking how far it is.
proc: A rhythm found only by moving, step after step.
Rhythm is found only by moving, step after step.

obraz: A parcel sits on the step, taped shut, with no sender's name.
proc: A closed vessel whose contents are not yet known.
A closed vessel whose content exists but is not yet known.

obraz: You turn the map on your phone, and the street falls into place.
proc: A turn after which the same world reads differently.
One turn and the same world reads differently.

obraz: The plank across the stream holds because each bank carries one end.
proc: What holds between two sides belongs to both.
What holds arises between two sides and belongs to both.

obraz: Everyone agreed in the corridor; on the form there is one name, and it is yours.
proc: Standing by one's word alone and carrying the cost.
One person takes the side on record and bears its cost.

obraz: After weeks on the sofa, the stiff knee meets the stairs.
proc: What was left unused has lost its strength.
What was left standing has lost its strength.

obraz: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
proc: Scarcity shows what is truly needed.
Scarcity presses and shows what is truly needed.

obraz: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
proc: One learns about oneself through another person.
One learns about oneself through another person's mirror.

obraz: Said aloud, the plan sounds different from the one in your head.
proc: Speech heard aloud changes the meaning of the thing.
Spoken words change what the thing means.

obraz: The coins dropped in the jar each evening are, one day, the fare.
proc: Small acts over time ripen into a result.
Small acts over time ripen into a result.

obraz: The recipe card is in another hand, with one change added in yours.
proc: Something inherited, with a choice about what to carry on.
Something handed down and the choice of how to carry it on.

obraz: The borrowed book comes back with a bar of chocolate on top.
proc: An uncounted gift passed back between two hands.
Giving goes back and forth, with more than was owed.

obraz: The flock feeds head down, and one goose stands with its neck straight.
proc: One stands watch between a threat and what it protects.
One stands alert on watch for the rest.

obraz: The candle kept for a special evening has never been lit.
proc: Value kept unused never gets to live.
Value kept unused never comes alive.

obraz: On the first warm day every door on the street stands open.
proc: A shared lightening when things fall into place.
A shared lightening in the middle of ordinary days.

obraz: The eider plucks her own down to line the nest.
proc: Care given so that new small life can grow.
Care preparing room for fragile new life.

obraz: The cold of the river at your ankles stops you before the current does.
proc: A sharp stop at the threshold that protects from what lies ahead.
A sharp sensation at the threshold stops the step before harm.

obraz: A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
proc: Something moving is stopped and held as it is.
Motion is frozen and held as it is.

obraz: The swell lifts the boat before any wave can be seen.
proc: A hidden movement of water felt before it is seen.
Movement under the surface is felt before it can be seen.

obraz: The phone light finds the dropped key, and beside it a long-lost earring.
proc: A small light reveals something that was there all along.
A small light reveals something that was there all along.

obraz: An unnamed voice memo sits in your phone, three minutes long.
proc: Something exists but is not yet known or named.
Content exists but is closed and not yet known.

obraz: The tide has turned, and the same boats now point the other way.
proc: A turn after which the same things face the other way.
A turn after which the same things face the other way.

obraz: The breath has to go out before the next one can come in.
proc: What is held must be passed on for more to come.
It only works while it keeps moving out and in.

obraz: You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
proc: Keeping to the truth and knowingly paying the price.
Keeping to the truth and knowingly paying the price.
